name: v3.2.3
body:
# [Super]CleveRoidMacros

## [v3.2.3](https://github.com/brues-code/SuperCleveRoidMacros/tree/v3.2.3) (2026-11-02)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/brues-code/SuperCleveRoidMacros/compare/v3.2.2...v3.2.3) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/brues-code/SuperCleveRoidMacros/releases)

- Read an idle swing timer as 100% elapsed  
    A timer past its end means the next swing is ready and only waits on the  
    player (moving, casting Aimed Shot, not attacking). [swingtimer] and  
    [rangedtimer] read it as 100% again, as they did under SP\_SwingTimer,  
    instead of failing every comparison, so [rtimer:>80] passes while the  
    next shot is held back. The Slam and ranged clip checks are unchanged.  
- Publish the passing clause's @unit as the macro button's range unit  
    - PublishDisplay hands C\_Macro.SetMacroDisplay the clause's @unit (marks  
      resolved), which ClassicAPI v1.18.1 resolves at every range check, so the  
      button's range follows a new mouseover or focus with no republish. The  
      unit joins the no-op cache, and a change of unit alone (a multi-group  
      clause falling to another group) counts as a change  
    - Screen non-token strings (@Name, typos) with IsUnitToken: UnitExists  
      raises on them just as C\_Spell.IsSpellInRange and SetMacroDisplay do  
- bump CAPI min to 1.18.1  
- Read range, stance and auto-repeat state from ClassicAPI; require v1.18.0  
    - Button range, [inrange]/[outrange] and their negations (count mode too)  
      and the no-UnitXP melee fallback read C\_Spell.IsSpellInRange, which  
      v1.18.0 gates on the target. Drop the Nampower range wrapper, its  
      rangeIndex / implicit-target helpers, the UnitXP distance fallback and  
      the spell ID / name caches. nil (a rangeless spell, or a unit the spell  
      can't be cast at) passes neither [inrange] nor [outrange]  
    - [stance]/[form] read GetShapeshiftForm(true), so forms off the stance bar  
      (Shadowform, Stealth, Ghost Wolf) count as one past the bar  
    - The Auto Shot / Shoot recast guard reads IsAutoRepeatSpell, so the spell  
      need not be on an action bar; drop the autoShot / wand flags  
    - Drop the unused CleveRoids.GetMacroBody  
- Read cast times from C\_Spell.GetSpellInfo; require ClassicAPI v1.17.0  
    ClassicAPI v1.17.0 reports the player's own castTime (talents, cast speed),  
    so [spellcasttime] and the Slam clip check read C\_Spell.GetSpellInfo  
    instead of scanning spellbook tooltips. Drop both tooltip scanners, their  
    caches, RefreshSlamCastTime/ClearSpellCastTimeCache, GetSlamSpellSlot and  
    the Nampower DBC cast-time fallback.  
- Classify debuffs from Spell.dbc; learn CC immunity from missing debuffs  
    - Drop personalDebuffs; sharedDebuffs becomes an ID set behind  
      lib.IsSharedDebuff (ID, then base name)  
    - Rank-specific [debuff]/[buff] matching compares C\_Spell.GetSpellSubtext,  
      replacing the spell-name cache  
    - CC types come from ClassicAPI mechanics and aura types only:  
      GetSpellCCType (CC that stops the whole spell) and GetAuraCCType  
      (CC of the debuff it applies)  
    - Any harmful aura spell is expected; a missing bleed or CC debuff  
      records bleed / cc\_<type> immunity instead of a school immunity  
- Use ClassicAPI's native focus token; drop pfUI focus emulation  
- Drop the hooksecurefunc fallback; ClassicAPI provides it  
- Read spell schools from Spell.dbc through ClassicAPI  
    GetSpellSchool resolves a name through the spellbook and reads ClassicAPI's  
    GetSpellSchool(spellID), with bleeds from the DBC mechanic. Drop the  
    non-damaging spell table, tooltip scanner, name patterns, BLEED\_SPELL\_IDS,  
    the combat-log school learner, CleveRoids\_SpellSchools and its commands.  
    A missing personal bleed of any kind now records bleed immunity.  
- Key the bleed boss list on NPC ID  
    Spawn GUIDs named one spawn each and broke on respawn renumbering; the  
    NPC ID (UnitCreatureID) covers every spawn.  
- Remove duration bookkeeping now that ClassicAPI reports aura durations  
    Delete ComboPointTracker.lua, the talent/equipment/set-bonus duration  
    modifiers, nampower's GetSpellModifiers wrappers, the learned-duration  
    SavedVariables and their commands, and the /cast combo pre-tracking.  
    sentCasts keeps only the send time. The bleed tables move into Utility.lua  
    beside the aura expectations that read them.  
- Replace libdebuff's tracking pipeline with combat-log aura expectations  
    The aura conditionals read C\_UnitAuras, so libdebuff's cast and aura event  
    handlers, its delayed verification frame, lib.objects and the tables beside  
    it, castTracking, AddEffect/GetDuration/UnitDebuff/UnitBuff, the pfUI table  
    linking and nampower's SPELL\_START/SPELL\_GO CVar setup have no readers left.  
    Aura expectations take over what still mattered. The player's hit  
    (SPELL\_CAST\_SUCCESS, SPELL\_DAMAGE, RANGE\_DAMAGE) expects the debuff it  
    applies; SPELL\_AURA\_APPLIED, a miss or a C\_UnitAuras check settles it. A  
    personal debuff still missing after 0.4s is an immunity the server never  
    reports, recorded as bleed or school immunity behind the old guards. The  
    expectations also answer IsPendingDebuffCast, and the player's CC landing  
    counts toward the DR safeguard.  
    The CC and shared-debuff missing-aura verifiers are dropped: with nampower's  
    SPELL\_GO they short-circuited on spellGoHit and never recorded anything.  
- Record immunity from periodic and damage-shield IMMUNE events  
    ClassicAPI now logs SMSG\_SPELLORDAMAGE\_IMMUNE, a target immune to the damage of  
    a periodic tick or a damage shield, as DAMAGE\_SHIELD\_MISSED (or  
    SPELL\_PERIODIC\_MISSED) with missType IMMUNE. Route the player's through  
    ProcessSpellMissSelf like SPELL\_MISSED, restoring the school immunity the old  
    chat parser read from the same packet's IMMUNESPELL line.  
- Resolve aura conditionals through C\_UnitAuras  
    ValidateAura and ValidateUnitDebuff resolve every unit through one  
    C\_UnitAuras.UnitAura scan: polarity-based, so an overflowed debuff still reads  
    harmful, with expirationTime for time left and applications for stacks. On  
    another unit a personal debuff counts only when the player or pet cast it.  
    Remove the libdebuff lib.objects and lib:UnitDebuff timer reads, nampower's  
    FindUnitAuraInfo/GetUnitAuras/UnitHasAura/GetUnitAuraApplications,  
    GetPlayerAura, and the slot-by-slot scans. Fix the BUFF\_UPDATE\_DURATION\_SELF  
    handler reading an API local scoped to another branch.  
- Read cast state from ClassicAPI's cast info and UNIT\_SPELLCAST events  
    [casting], [channeled], [casttime], [channeltime], [selfcasting] and the  
    pending-debuff check read C\_Spell.CastingInfo/ChannelInfo through  
    CleveRoids.GetPlayerCast, which carry the effective cast time and pushback.  
    CheckSpellCast reads C\_Spell.UnitCastingInfo/UnitChannelInfo for any unit.  
    Core's UNIT\_SPELLCAST\_* handlers refresh the buttons, advance /castsequence on  
    SUCCEEDED, and record each sent cast with a finisher's combo points in  
    CleveRoids.sentCasts. Remove Core's UNIT\_CASTEVENT, SPELL\_CAST\_EVENT,  
    SPELL\_START\_SELF, SPELL\_FAILED\_SELF and SPELLCAST\_* handlers, spell\_tracking,  
    the cast/channel timers, CurrentSpell.type/spellName, UpdateCastingState,  
    lastCastSpell, the unread castsequence status/expires, and the tooltip  
    channel-duration lookup.  
- Drive combat tracking from COMBAT\_LOG\_EVENT\_UNFILTERED  
    Replace the chat-text parsers and nampower's SPELL\_MISS, SPELL\_DAMAGE\_EVENT,  
    AUTO\_ATTACK and UNIT\_DIED events with ClassicAPI's combat log. One dispatcher  
    in Utility.lua feeds immunity learning, reactive procs, resist state,  
    spell-school learning, CC/bleed landing and death cleanup; Conditionals.lua  
    records [lastswing]/[incominghit] from the combat log's miss type and flags.  
    The Cursive Judgement refresh keys on the swing's target GUID.  
    Remove the delayed miss-reason correlation, the evLearn fallback frame, and  
    the RAW\_COMBATLOG fade learner, which never matched because it stripped 0x  
    from GUIDs before the lookup.
